summary: 08:00 stale check for the plain Postgres snapshot. Desktop tag.
description: SSH-bridge wrapper. Posts DB backup: STALE when no plain success is newer than 26 hours. A fresh 07:50 success posts nothing from this job. Operator decision 2026-11-10.
content:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
ssh -i /tmp/windmill/worker_to_windows -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes lndco@host.docker.internal "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\lndco\antiphon-snapshot-runner\invoke-postgres-snapshot-stale.ps1"
exit $?
